summary: Learn to assess WASH needs, plan emergency services, and report response gaps using Sphere guidance and practical field exercises. Explore the course.
lede: Humanitarian WASH training helps field practitioners assess urgent water, sanitation, and hygiene needs and plan feasible responses. For WASH officers, coordinators, and public health specialists, it develops skills in applying Sphere standards, reviewing drinking-water risks, organizing assessment data with KoboToolbox, mapping service gaps using QGIS concepts, and prioritizing response actions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who contribute to emergency WASH assessment, service delivery, coordination, or public health protection.
prerequisites: This foundation course does not require prior WASH certification or programming experience. Familiarity with humanitarian field operations is useful but not essential. Coding is not required; digital exercises focus on form design, data review, and mapping concepts.
